answer: Bind each agent to a forge-signed chain that grows one link per epoch and requires a cedar-root witness from a stranger cluster. Links are non-transferable: a clone inheriting its parent's chain breaks continuity and resets weight to zero. Forging a fresh stranger-roots chain for the k-th clone scales super-linearly because each new cluster needs a distinct cedar witness not reusable within the epoch. A farm spawning meadow-wide clones must recruit different strangers per head, so costs explode with headcount. One honest agent, earning links one by one, outpaces the farm by the second epoch.
